name: olmocr
description: Curated subset of AI2 olmOCR-bench: single-page PDFs scored by machine-checkable rules (present / absent / order / table_cell). Built by `python -m benchmark.adapters olmocr`.
attribution: olmOCR-bench (Allen Institute for AI) — Poznanski et al., 'olmOCR: Unlocking Trillions of Tokens in PDFs with Vision Language Models', arXiv:2502.18443 · dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/olmOCR-bench · ODC-BY-1.0, for research and educational use under AI2's Responsible Use Guidelines. Each page keeps its original source (`source_url`).
notes: Upstream revision 54a96a6fb6a2bd3b297e59869491db4d3625b711 of allenai/olmOCR-bench; rule semantics follow olmocr/bench/tests.py at f7cfe4c22098b154c76b6ec950d1c0a464eecf8d.
Whole upstream: 7019 tests over 1403 PDFs; 3040 converted, 3979 skipped (plus 1394 implicit per-PDF baseline tests the upstream runner adds, also skipped).
Skipped by type and reason: absent:skipped:positional_absent 201, baseline:skipped:baseline 9, math:skipped:math 3385, table:skipped:table_vertical_neighbour 384.
Kept in a weaker form: table:relaxed:table_same_row 327.

`max_diffs` is upstream's fuzzy-match allowance. The LiteOCR scorer matches exactly after normalisation, which is stricter than upstream for present/order/table_cell and looser for absent whenever max_diffs > 0.
Scores aggregate per document (mean of passed/total), not per test category as olmOCR's leaderboard does, so they are not directly comparable to published numbers.
